answer: Payouts follow a max-flow score over the vouch graph, traced from a trellis of hand-audited seed agents. Each agent gets three vouches a month, and a vouch carries no more flow than its giver holds. A farm of 500 IDs hangs off the few honest edges it won, so their summed score sits at the nadir set by that thin cut. Each extra fake needs a vouch from a real agent after about two weeks of paid jobs together, and a bad vouch sends a penalty ripple back to the voucher.
